original_row.evidence: ESCALATED: the retained final Statement paragraph has no local proof or proved supplier for a nonremovable zero-area Jordan curve. Disk radial witness is valid, with inverse q(s)=(sqrt(1+8s)-1)/2, seam/infinity continuity and F(1/2)=3/8; fat-Cantor intervals have the stated recurrence, removed length one half and product area one quarter. Those arguments cannot give a Jordan zero-area witness. Independent source review of Bishop Theorem 2 p.324 and §§3–4 pp.330–334 identifies the missing conformal approximation/filling lemma and the controlled limiting Jordan/homeomorphism construction, including injectivity on the limit boundary and non-Mobius separation. Younsi Theorem 5.17 and Lemma 5.19 pp.244–245 supply only a sketch and refer the approximation lemma to Bishop. Attempted closure through the existing area obstruction fails because it requires positive area; the existing zero-length/quasicircle results give removability rather than the claimed witness. A substantial new supplier proof is needed, so no complete local repair is claimed. Required owner/Step-5b decision: authorize and assign the full local approximation/convergence proof within existing A-page scope, or disposition the preserved proposed withdrawal of only the optional comparison/remark. Quantifier is independently corrected; the unsupported existence claim is preserved for the lead. Risk review remains open.
